title: 2016. Maximum Difference Between Increasing Elements

examples.explanation: The maximum difference occurs with i = 1 and j = 2, nums[j] - nums[i] = 5 - 1 = 4. Note that with i = 1 and j = 0, the difference nums[j] - nums[i] = 7 - 1 = 6, but i > j, so it is not valid.
There is no i and j such that i < j and nums[i] < nums[j].
The maximum difference occurs with i = 0 and j = 3, nums[j] - nums[i] = 10 - 1 = 9.
